categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches disk flatfile storage primitives and VarInt serialization testing, not peer-to-peer networking or relay.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Standardizes disk storage primitive types across flatfile logic and adds unit test coverage for VarInt serialization overflow.
categories.rationale: Standardizes flatfile size types to 64-bit unsigned integers to avoid brittle type handling and adds test coverage for VarInt overflow. Author notes that 'using 32-bit integers or architecture-dependent integers is brittle and confusing' and commit notes 'there is no test coverage at all for VarInt overflow behavior'.
